description: Walk the knowledge graph outward from a concept and return everything within `depth` hops, with distance and the edge path that reached it. Use to map the blast radius before changing a feature (what depends on it, what constrains it, which decisions apply) or to discover structure that keyword search misses. Filter by relation names (e.g. depends_on) to follow only one kind of edge.

depth.description: How many hops to traverse (1-3, default 1).

relations.description: Only follow edges with these relation names, e.g. ["depends_on", "part_of"].

name: get_related
title: Get related concepts
